title: Shame-proneness and authenticity in emerging adulthood
abstract: Context and relevance. Authenticity is associated with well-being and is one of the conditions for the full functioning of the personality. However, maintaining authenticity may be associated with social risks. Shame, as a self-conscious emotion directed at the self and associated with the fear of social isolation, may restrict the expression of authenticity. The challenges of searching for the self and the consequences of shame-proneness are especially important in emerging adulthood, when decisions taken can critically affect life. Objective. To identify the presence and specific features of the relationship between personal authenticity and shame-proneness in emerging adulthood. Hypothesis. The level of personal authenticity is interconnected with shame experience, while the relationships of such experience with the various components of authenticity will be ambiguous. Methods and materials. The study involved 133 young people aged 18 to 29 (M = 23,8, SD = 2,9, 41,4% male). Authenticity, shame-proneness and the expression of traits in emerging adulthood were assessed using a battery of questionnaires (Moscow Authenticity Scale, Authenticity Scale, TOSCA-3, GASP, Inventory of the Dimensions of Emerging Adulthood). Results. Divergent relations of moderate strength were identified between shame-proneness and the components of authenticity, taking into account the traits of emerging adulthood. Shame-proneness is positively associated with self-alienation and accepting external influence, and is negatively related to authentic living. For authenticity measured with the Moscow Authenticity Scale, a negative relation was found between shame-proneness and the aspects of authenticity related to knowing and accepting oneself. Conclusions. The identified connections are weak or moderate in strength, which suggests that the consequences of a tendency to experience shame can be offset by an authentic person's ability to accept their imperfections and their high capacity to follow their purpose and accept life's circumstances.
